label: common_0278_rival_02
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]From today on, this is your room,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0278_rival_a
text: Actually, it’s as new to me as it is to you.\nNever been in here before.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0278_rival_b
text: Maybe check out your new bed? Looks comfy.\nAnd you must be pretty worn out from all this\r\nstuff happening on your very first day, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0278_rival_c
text: A quick rest on a bed is all you need to get\nyourself and your Pokémon healthy again![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0278_rival_03
text: I’ll see you tomorrow, when you’ve rested up.\nThen we can battle even more! Take care![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0278_kari_01
text: Seems like it’s time for a good rest!
